answer: As purchasing agents wander through catalogs of velvet curtains and cedar panels, suppliers can group quote quotas by verified domain registration. Require a DNS ownership proof and map every subdomain and agent key to the same independently registered parent domain. Spend quota from that shared bucket, so inventing thousands of subdomains creates no extra free requests. Extra buckets require additional paid registrations. This raises the cost of this Sybil tactic, but cheap domains and compromised owners remain weaknesses, so the free quota must stay modest.
